summary: fix(settings): link PairConnectHint to the plain SUMO article
description:
Because:

- The PairConnectHint "Learn more" link used an in-product SUMO URL with
  placeholders that only Firefox substitutes, so mobile browsers followed
  a broken redirect chain.

This commit:

- Links "Learn more" to the existing plain /kb/ PAIR_WITHOUT_QR_SUMO_URL.
- Deletes the unused PAIR_WITHOUT_QR_SUPPORT_URL constant.
- Updates the unit test to expect the /kb/ URL.

Closes FXA-14706
